title: Kim and the Little Click
synopsis: Kim visits the newly quiet Story House with Todd, whose damp yellow boots say shup; she notices the small click of the repaired door latch.
continuity_state: Before: The Story House hinge is repaired and latch clicks softly. Kim lives near Round Pond with exactly three pebbles in her violet pouch. Todd and Aunt Pat come from Reed Meadow, and Todd wears two yellow boots, one blue-patched. After: Kim has personally heard the new latch click, Todd jokes that his boots say shup only when damp. Kim retains all three pebbles, Todd retains both yellow boots, and no finished Book of Little Sounds page or other shelf item is changed. They return east with their grown-ups, then part at Round Pond.
